--- name: bukSyncSkill description: Imports the BUK employee roster into fstrabajador and records the run in fsejecucionfuente. ---
# BUK: Sync Employees
Reads `GET /employees` from BUK page by page (read-only, token from `FULSERVICE_BUK_API_TOKEN`), upserts `fstrabajador` by BUK id and appends a redacted `fsregistrocrudo` row. Sensitive fields (RUT, wage, bank, health, family, contact) are never stored.
## When to use
- The repeating `buk_sync` agent job (scheduled) or "Import now" from the agent job monitor.
## Output
One `fsejecucionfuente` row per run with status (success, partial, failed), counts and error code; progress lines in the agent job run logs.
